goal: Регистрация на рейс в аэропорту: паспорт, багаж, место в самолёте. Лечу с одним чемоданом и рюкзаком

scenes.brief:
Situation: At the airport check-in counter before the flight. The learner is checking in with a passport, traveling with one suitcase and one backpack, and wants to handle baggage and ask about a seat on the plane.
Learner: the learner is a passenger. Partner: the partner is a check-in agent.
Learner must be able to: show a passport and booking, say they have one suitcase and one backpack, ask for a window or aisle seat, understand basic flight details such as gate number and boarding time.
Partner will: ask for passport and ticket, ask how many bags the passenger has and whether any bag is for check-in, give a boarding pass and basic flight information.
Not in this scene: security screening, passport control, boarding the plane.

Situation: At the same airport check-in counter, but there is a baggage problem. The learner is flying with one suitcase and one backpack, and the suitcase is too heavy or the baggage rules are unclear.
Learner: the learner is a passenger. Partner: the partner is a check-in agent.
Learner must be able to: understand that the suitcase is overweight, ask how much the extra fee is, ask what can go in the cabin and what must be checked, decide what to do with the backpack or items from the suitcase.
Partner will: say the baggage is over the limit, explain the fee or baggage rule, tell the passenger what items can stay in the cabin or must be moved.
Not in this scene: showing travel documents for the first time, choosing a seat, finding the gate, boarding the plane.

topic.description_target: Check in for a flight, show your passport, talk about bags, and ask about your seat.
topic.description_native: Зарегистрируйтесь на рейс, покажите паспорт, скажите про багаж и спросите о месте.

messages.speaker: A
messages.text_target: Good morning. May I see your passport, please?
messages.text_native: Доброе утро. Можно ваш паспорт, пожалуйста?

check.text_target: What document does the agent ask for?

messages.speaker: A
messages.text_target: Thank you. Do you also have your booking confirmation?
messages.text_native: Спасибо. У вас ещё есть подтверждение бронирования?

check.text_target: What else does the agent want to see?
check.text_native: Что ещё хочет увидеть сотрудница регистрации?

messages.speaker: A
messages.text_target: How many bags do you have today?

messages.speaker: B
messages.text_target: I have one suitcase and one backpack.
messages.text_native: У меня один чемодан и один рюкзак.
messages.pronunciation_native: Ай хэв уан сьюткэйс энд уан бэкпэк.

check.text_target: How many items does the agent ask about?
check.text_native: О количестве чего спрашивает сотрудница регистрации?
check.explanation_native: Она спрашивает, сколько у пассажира сумок.

messages.speaker: B
messages.text_target: I'd like to check this suitcase.
messages.pronunciation_native: Айд лайк ту чек зис сьюткэйс.
simplified_variants: I want to check this suitcase.

messages.speaker: A
messages.text_target: Sure. The backpack can stay with you.
messages.text_native: Конечно. Рюкзак может остаться у вас.

check.text_target: Which bag can the passenger keep?
check.text_native: Какую сумку пассажир может оставить при себе?
check.explanation_native: Сотрудница регистрации говорит, что рюкзак можно оставить при себе.

messages.speaker: B
messages.text_target: Can I have a window seat?
messages.pronunciation_native: Кэн ай хэв э уиндоу сит?

messages.speaker: A
messages.text_target: Yes, seat 14A is by the window.

check.text_target: Which seat does the agent give?

messages.speaker: A
messages.text_target: Your flight leaves from gate 22. Boarding starts at 10:15.
messages.text_native: Ваш рейс вылетает от выхода 22. Посадка начинается в 10:15.

check.explanation_native: Сотрудница регистрации говорит, что посадка начинается в 10:15.

messages.speaker: B
messages.text_target: Sorry, could you say that more slowly?
messages.pronunciation_native: Сoри, куд ю сэй зэт мор слoули?

check.text_target: What gate number does the agent repeat?
check.text_native: Какой номер выхода повторяет сотрудница регистрации?

messages.speaker: B
messages.text_target: Can I have an aisle seat?
messages.pronunciation_native: Кэн ай хэв эн айл сит?

messages.speaker: A
messages.text_target: I'm sorry, only window seats are available now.
messages.text_native: Извините, сейчас доступны только места у окна.

check.text_target: Which seats are still available now?

options.text_target: Only seats next to the window

check.explanation_native: Сотрудница регистрации говорит, что сейчас доступны только места у окна.

questions.explanation_native: Пассажир говорит, что хочет сдать чемодан.
Сначала пассажир просит место у окна.
Сотрудница регистрации говорит, что посадка начинается в 10:15.
